server.harness:
bash -c 
set -euo pipefail
for row in smooth:1.5:baseline quality:2:baseline smooth:1.5:msaa2 quality:2:msaa4; do
 IFS=: read -r mode dpr aa <<< "$row"
 GT3_OUT=local/evidence/p3u/W3/perf-$mode-$aa-day GT3_DURATION=65 GT3_RENDER_DPR=$dpr GT3_QUERY="?version=unlocked&mode=$mode" GT3_CANDIDATE=$aa node scripts/p3u-perf.mjs
done
